comparison.trajectoryAuditScope: Retain all six traces per arm as emitted. No physical or neural replay and no independent full-step trajectory reconstruction is part of this 156-flight plan; source, stored endpoint/progress, and optimizer arithmetic checks define its audit scope.

pairedVerification: Before any launch, hash all 72 reused runtime inputs, frozen G8, calibration basis, native binary/build record, source, plan, both initial-state snapshots, absolute Node executable/version, and cleaned explicit environments. Require the only arm difference affecting computation to be initial sigma; output names may differ.

Reconstruct generation-one optimizer/proposal arithmetic offline using the pinned JavaScript operation order and RNG, without importing the worker-spawning trainer or running flight/neural code. Standard expected state must equal the native no-state initial path plus SUITE_INITIAL; quarter covariance must equal standard covariance/16 and diagonal Cholesky factor standard/4.

Check all 12 retained parameter vectors in each arm exactly against that prescribed reconstruction, after the same JSON numeric boundary. Check every fixed coordinate equals frozen G8 and each candidate index consumes the same 28-normal draw vector in both arms. Preserve every draw/reconstruction identity for audit.

For candidates 1..11, verify quarter pre-addition displacement equals 0.25 times standard displacement with the same 0.4/1.4 multiplier. Final stored p-minus-mean differences can differ at floating-point subtraction precision; exact independently reconstructed parameter equality is the decisive check, while a scale-aware floating-point residual is reported for the derived quarter-delta relation.

Candidate 0 in both arms must equal frozen G8 in all 28 parameters and all 21300 decoded Float64 weights. Its six case descriptors and complete stored flight result objects must agree exactly across arms at the native JSON serialization boundary. The frozen trainer archives JSON ledger results, not V8 raw-return files. A mismatch is an audit failure requiring explanation, not a new training attempt.

Independently recompute every original candidate fitness, original milestone comparator key/full order, H/P mean, selected identity, elite set, post-generation mean/sigma/covariance, complete state/checkpoint/history, and decoded selected weights. Require generation 1 and episodes 72 in each final state.

Observe both original training process exits as zero before opening result files for the completion audit. Preserve original handles and terminal receipts; no restarting or silent replacement. Freeze selected identities after that audit and verify comparison parameters/weights against them before and after all 12 comparison flights.
completeReporting: Publish all 144 training endpoints indexed by arm/candidate/case and all 12 comparison endpoints indexed by arm/case, including timeouts, failures, and no-eligible cases; missing data are explicitly incomplete and never silently dropped.

For each of the 11 matched stochastic proposals, report sigma arm, index, original 0.4/1.4 multiplier, all 28 coefficients or retained identity, displacement magnitude, landing/milestone primary keys, original fitness and components, H, P, eligible/no-eligible trip counts, failure reasons, and full original rank.

Predeclare three proposal-locality counts among the 11 stochastic candidates in each arm: mean P>0; primary landing/milestone key lexicographically at least the shared initial candidate key; and both conditions together. Show all 11 matched indicators and arm counts, alongside the full original fitness/order and every endpoint. Treat these as descriptive paired development measures, not independent-trial significance or a release test.

Report paired changes in primary-key preservation relative to the shared initial candidate, count of positive-P proposals, eligible trips, longest strict hold, maximum conditional periapsis, and original reward. Separate the stochastic 11-candidate summary from the two identical candidate-0 baselines; show every paired difference before aggregates.

Report selected-controller identities and all six fixed comparison pairs: original stable-orbit, full-orbit, return, and landing outcomes; recorded full-flight endpoint reason/time; original score/reward; strict hold H; and conditional-periapsis P. Restrict derived deficits to stored endpoint/hold/progress fields, for example max(0, 800 - conditionalPeriapsis) at the recorded eligible peak, reported as unavailable when no eligible observation exists, or max(0, 3 - longestStrictInsertionHoldSeconds). Retain all comparison traces as recorded, without requiring physical replay, reconstructed full-step deficits, or independent trajectory verification.

Positive P, better original fitness, or primary-key preservation can support only the proposed locality diagnosis. They do not replace unchanged physical completion predicates. This is one matched 11-direction population around one frozen controller on reused training cases, followed by six comparison cases; do not call it convergence, broad reliability, a release qualification, or permission to increase the budget.
